features.name: Event Creation & Management
requirements: Create, edit, and publish event pages in under 10 minutes
Set capacity limits and manage waitlists

features.name: Ticketing & Delivery
requirements: Support up to 10,000 attendees per event

features.name: Payment Processing & Payouts
requirements: Stripe Connect integration for payment acceptance
14-day payout hold post-event for chargeback windows

features.name: Refund Processing & Dispute Resolution
requirements: Organizer-controlled approval workflow with reason visibility
Block refunds after event check-in based on attendance records
Flag and block duplicate refund requests
Manual review for refunds within 24 hours of event

features.name: Event Discovery & Search
requirements: Public event listings and featured events
Search and filtering by category, date, location

features.name: Admin Moderation & Compliance
requirements: Platform-wide event management and content moderation
Automated flagging for prohibited categories and risk signals
Manual review within 24 hours of report
Organizer suspension (temporary 30 days or permanent) with appeal process
Chargeback monitoring and dispute response within 24 hours
Audit logs and GDPR/CCPA compliance tracking

success_metrics: Event creation completion rate of 80% within 10 minutes
Concurrent capacity of 500+ users per event
constraints: No mobile wallet support in V1
Data retained for 7 years for compliance
Data deletion within 30 days (with legal exceptions)
Non-critical features may degrade at 400-500 concurrent users
edge_cases: Refund requests within 24 hours of event trigger manual review
Duplicate refund requests are flagged and blocked
Refunds cannot be requested after event check-in
Organizers with 3+ chargebacks in 12 months flagged for suspension review
Payouts withheld if organizer has open disputes or fraud flags
Failed payouts trigger notifications and retries
Fraud patterns from multiple refunds by same attendee logged for risk scoring
Organizers retain read-only access to data during temporary suspension
